After the '''Fallen King''' gains its shield health, it will immediately perform its ''Spin Slash'' ability. |music-1 = '''Version 1 & 3''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Fallen Boss|center|250px|thumb]] |music-2 = '''Version 2''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Void Steps (Fallen King Theme)|center|250px|thumb]] |music-3 = '''Played during Classic Castle''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - The Classic Theme|center|250px|thumb]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|oiHSADAsdoisada;lad'111111111111|Beginning of Wave 40 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fallen King''' is the final boss in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode. It was also formerly the final boss in the [[The Classic Event]]. Although it moves somewhat slowly (during its ''Rage Mode'', it moves much faster), it has an extreme amount of health and many abilities that can stun several towers and destroy units, making it one of the most difficult challenges in the game. Additionally, the '''Fallen King''' is a [[Boss]] enemy, making it immune to most forms of stalling and the [[Nuke]]'s fallout damage. It stops moving when performing its ''Stomp'', ''Rage Mode'', ''Block'' and ''Summon'' abilities. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Fallen King''' appears to be a being of living stone as the boss appears to be entirely made of granite stone. It is much larger than most [[enemies]] that spawn before it, even larger than a normal-sized player. It wears a crown and cape akin to a king's attire, a sword in its scabbard and has a shield on its left hand, all made of stone as well. It has reflective black skin and radiates purple energy. It is wearing full body armor, including purple boots, and appears to be faceless. However, it gains light blue eyes, a purple-red aura and emits red light upon ''Rage Mode''. The armor has multiple light blue glowing parts, on its torso, armbands and kneepads. |Hardcore Testing |This version of the '''Fallen King''' was nearly the same as the original version, except the sword it carried was a glowing purple sword with a purple crystal in the middle of it. |Original |The original '''Fallen King''' appeared to be a being of living stone as the boss appears to be entirely made of granite stone. It wore a crown and cape akin to a king's attire, a sword on its right hand and a shield on its left hand, all made of stone as well. It was wearing full body armor, including black boots, and appeared to be faceless. However, it gained purple eyes, a purple-red aura and emitted red light upon ''Rage Mode''. It radiated purple energy. It was much larger than every enemy that spawned before it. }} ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Engineer]] and [[Ranger]] are recommended against the '''Fallen King'''. **The [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] are immune to all stuns from the '''Fallen King's''' abilities, making them very useful against the '''Fallen King'''. *The '''Fallen King''' cannot be slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]] or confused by the [[Jester]]. **As it is a boss enemy, it cannot be frozen though it can still be slowed down through chillness by freezing towers, though it will be less effective. **Stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] can only slow it down instead of stunning it. *While the '''Fallen King''' performs its ''Block'' ability, it becomes immune to all sources of damage. It is immobile while the ability is active, as this is mainly to waste time or waste ability duration. **This can be used as a breathing point to manage your troops, but do not use abilities such as the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' while this ability is still active. **[[Units]] will pass through the '''Fallen King''' as it performs its ''Block'' ability. **The '''Fallen King''' will also briefly become immune to all attacks when ''Rage Mode'' is activated. **Sometimes, the '''Fallen King''' may use this ability early when most of the enemies are still alive, which gives your towers more time to attack the enemies that are in front of the '''Fallen King'''. *The '''Fallen King''' is accompanied by four [[Fallen Guardian (Legacy)|Fallen Guardian]]s. They are always in front of the '''Fallen King'''. They should be fought first since they are faster than the '''Fallen King'''. *Beware of the '''Fallen King's''' ''Stomp'' attack. This covers an enormous radius around the boss, stunning any ground troops caught in the radius. **Cliff towers and air-based towers, such as the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] are not affected by this attack. **You can use the [[Medic]]'s ability to shield towers from stuns. The [[Medic]] itself is immune to all of the '''Fallen King's''' attacks. **The ''Stomp'' attack will instantly destroy most [[units]] caught in the shockwave, as it deals 500 damage to all units. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyFallenKing.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} FallenKingHardcore.png|[[Hardcore Testing BETA]] version FallenKing.png|First version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} 8e68dde0871a3ae39ac11b8dd12afe69.jpg|'''Fallen King''' on the game thumbnail. 2d88c0cd2af6124d90a50dfd35056109.jpg|'''Fallen King''' on the game thumbnail. War Machine Upgrade 5.png|'''Fallen King''' on the [[War Machine]]'s Level 5 upgrade icon and [[Accelerator]]’s first Level 5 upgrade icon. 170UpdateLog2.png|'''Fallen King''' featured in the [[v1.7.0]] update log. }} ==Trivia== *The first version '''Fallen King's''' sword and shield are very similar to the {{RLinkC|416846710|Epic Golden Sword and Shield}}, and its crown is identical to the {{RLinkC|332772333|Korblox Ice Crown}}, both items from the Roblox catalog. **During [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], the '''Fallen King''' had a different type of sword. It was a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|4524644835|Cythrex' Sword}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Fallen King''' could be based on a phenomenon of a king losing his kingdom. **[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I-sH53vXP2A Fallen Kingdom] by CaptainSparklez is a viral example of this. **It could also represent a sort of fallen or lost kingdom, given some of the enemy names that appeared earlier. *The '''Fallen King''' was the only major boss of the three main gamemodes ([[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Molten Mode|Molten]], [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]]) that was not in the game before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]]. *The '''Fallen King''' used to appear alongside the [[Molten Boss]] on the second version of the "You Lost" screen. *The cape used by the original '''Fallen King''' was a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|2163546691|Black Iron Cape}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *A crewmate version of the original '''Fallen King''' can be seen on the ''Suspicious...'' [[Badges|badge]] and the April Fools 2021 [[Thumbnails|thumbnail]]. *The '''Fallen King''' can be seen as a chess piece in the [[Chess Board]] map, representing the King chess piece. *The '''Fallen King''' is the first major boss to have a variation of itself, being the [[Nuclear Fallen King]]. *The '''Fallen King''' was originally leaked alongside the [[Frozen (Pre-MEGA)|Frozen]], [[Deep Freeze (Pre-MEGA)|Deep Freeze]] and [[Frost Hero (Pre-MEGA)|Frost Hero]]. However, it was not released until the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]]. *The '''Fallen King's''' stomp radius is actually larger than the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]]'s stomp radius despite being weaker. *Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the '''Fallen King''' was one of the few enemies and the only boss to gain a shield. This shield reduced the damage dealt by most towers to 3. *The [[Logbooks|Logbook]] it drops only unlocks the entry for the [[Fallen King|modern version]] but not the legacy '''Fallen King'''. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text= *'''13 October 2019''' -
